projected_costs._premium_basis: No line has an unapplied Multi-AZ uplift: the RDS rate is baked_in Multi-AZ; Elastic Beanstalk's EC2 has no AZ-driven rate and its ALB is intrinsic. Premium equals Balanced, 210.
projected_costs._optimized_basis: Eligible subtotal 92 = Elastic Beanstalk EC2 component 92 (of 115: EC2 92 + ALB 16 + LCU 6 + EBS 1) x 0.30 compute_savings_plan -> 28; ineligible subtotal 118 unchanged (ALB, LCU and EBS 23, plus RDS PostgreSQL 95). RDS PostgreSQL 95 is ineligible for the Database Savings Plan: Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only (AWS Savings Plans FAQ, read 2026-11-27) and the design's db.t4g.medium is Generation 4; a Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g) would qualify at 0.20. 210 - 28 = 182. Rates from references/vendored/estimate/commitment-discount-ranges.json (compute_savings_plan 0.30; database_savings_plan_provisioned 0.20 not applied).

would_flip_if: A confirmed always-on traffic pattern would raise the AWS compute estimate materially.

optimization_opportunities.prerequisite: Establish an AWS compute usage baseline before committing
optimization_opportunities.description: Heroku dyno billing is flat-rate per dyno type; the Beanstalk EC2 usage pattern may differ. Covers the EC2 component (92 of the 115 Elastic Beanstalk line); the ALB, LCU and EBS components are not eligible.

optimization_opportunities.savings_percent: not applicable to db.t4g.medium (Generation 4); 20% (provisioned, 1-year no-upfront mid-point) on a Generation 7+ class
optimization_opportunities.timing: only after a move to a Generation 7+ instance class
optimization_opportunities.prerequisite: Move the RDS instance to a Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g); db.t4g.medium is Generation 4 and cannot be covered
optimization_opportunities.description: Heroku Postgres runs 24/7 with predictable usage, but the design's db.t4g.medium is Generation 4 and Database Savings Plans cover Generation 7 and newer instances only (AWS Savings Plans FAQ, read 2026-11-27), so no Database Savings Plan saving is claimed and the Optimized tier leaves the RDS line unchanged. A Generation 7+ class (for example db.m7g or db.r7g) would qualify at 20%. Mutually exclusive with RDS Reserved Instances on the same workload.
